title: 第7章 陈渊第8章 灵鱼出售三叔
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “初阳，你怎么看商家的婚约？”
父亲陈渊找到了陈初阳，面对面询问这个问题，他看着眼前的儿子，气质变得不一样了，第一次看到儿子，还以为认错人了，那股气质，那种感觉，让他惊讶了许久。
可能是许久不曾见面，也可能是对这个儿子了解不够深，导致了他有这种错觉，陈渊没有放在心上，和商家的婚约他也很在意，毕竟这个儿子从小和他不是很亲，很早就搬出来住，大部分时间都居住在龙蛇山上，很少在家，他本来和陈初阳见面的机会就少，陈家太多事情需要他去处理，父子时光那是少得可怜。
在家的时间都少，就算是有，也很少会关心这个儿子的事情，大部分心思都在大儿子身上，毕竟大儿子才是继承陈家家主位置的人，需要放更多的心思去培养大儿子，小儿子的话，修炼天赋普通，各方面都很普通，这样反而是好事，陈渊也松了一口气。
就怕陈初阳修炼天赋很好，超过了他大哥，那么，陈家家主的位置，可能就……他可不想陈家内乱，也不想看到兄弟反目的事情发生，对于陈初阳搬出来居住，陈渊是赞成的，如无必要，他也很少会来龙蛇山，因为这个儿子不喜欢其他人打扰他。
这一次，也是迫不得已。
“父亲你怎么看？”
陈初阳反问父亲，没有着急着给出答案，对于和商家的婚约，不过是两个家族之间的联姻，增强他们的关系，以此来确定他们的未来。
商家和陈家都是一样的想法，彼此都不放心，都需要用一些东西连接彼此。
大哥陈初升是不可能联姻的，也不可能被牺牲，那么，他这个小儿子，自然是要牺牲的那个。
对此，陈初阳没什么感觉，生在家族，就要有这样的觉悟，再说了，他对这种事情不反对，商红尘长得不错，如果是那种丑陋的女人，多少都会反对。
“我怎么看不重要，目前，商家商红尘那边不满意你，想要退婚，我想她肯定会找上来，到时候，我需要知道你的想法？”
“毕竟这一场婚约可不能随便取消，如果你不同意，那么，为父怎么也不会取消的。”
陈渊想要弥补这个儿子，一方面，退婚的话，确实影响儿子的名声，也会让他颜面扫地，以后无法在龙蛇城混下去，身为父亲，不能够不为儿子考虑。
另一方面，他需要陈初阳的态度，如果他也赞同，那么，这一场婚约可以商量，尽可能给儿子一些补偿。
“如果我也想取消呢？”
陈初阳抬起头，第一次观看这个父亲。
他眼里的父亲一直没变，这么多年都如此。
“你当真如此想？”
陈渊愣了一下，想不到陈初阳也有这样的想法。
商红尘，可是龙蛇城的大美女，多少男人的梦中情人，陈初阳和她有婚约在身，不知道羡慕死了多少人，也让很多人把陈初阳当做是敌人，一直针对他。
“红尘可是一个好女人，虽然现在任性了一点，可她的内心还是不错的。”
“这个丫头我和你母亲都很喜欢，如果不是她被天心宗看上了，我和你母亲都很乐意她当儿媳妇。”
看得出来，两人对商红尘很满意。
陈初阳默默听着，没有说话。
他听出了父亲的深层意思，说道：“一切听父亲的。”
“你不后悔？”
陈渊再次询问。
“这件事情一旦确定了，可就无法回头了，红尘……”
陈初阳点头：“嗯。”
他也不想多一个女人妨碍自己修炼，女人而已，不要就是了。
正所谓心中无女人，拔刀自然神。
他只想安静修炼，努力提升修为，争取早日能够长生。
其他的事情，都在长生之后。
content_en:
"Chu Yang, what do you think of the merchant's engagement?"
His father, Chen Yuan, found Chen Chuyang and asked him this question face to face. When he looked at his son, his temperament became different. When he saw his son for the first time, he thought he had recognized the wrong person. That temperament and feeling surprised him for a long time.
Maybe it was because they hadn't seen each other for a long time, or maybe they didn't know the son well enough, which caused him to have this misconception. Chen Yuan didn't take it to heart, and he also cared about the engagement with the merchant. After all, this son had not been very close to him since he was a child. He moved out very early and lived on Longshe Mountain most of the time, rarely at home. He had few opportunities to meet Chen Chuyang. There were too many things in the Chen family that he needed to deal with, and the time between father and son was pitiful.
He spends little time at home, and even if he does, he rarely cares about his son's affairs. Most of his thoughts are on the eldest son. After all, the eldest son is the one who will inherit the position of the head of the Chen family. More attention needs to be put on cultivating the eldest son. The younger son has ordinary cultivation talents and is average in all aspects. This is actually a good thing. Chen Yuan also breathed a sigh of relief.
He was afraid that Chen Chuyang was very talented in cultivation and surpassed his elder brother. Then, the position of the head of the Chen family might be... He didn't want the Chen family to be in civil strife, nor did he want to see the brothers turning against each other. Chen Yuan was in favor of Chen Chuyang moving out. He would rarely come to Long Snake Mountain if necessary, because this son didn't like other people to disturb him.
This time, it was also out of necessity.
"Father, what do you think?"
Chen Chuyang asked his father back, without rushing to give an answer. As for the marriage contract with the merchant, it was just a marriage between the two families to strengthen their relationship and determine their future.
Both the merchant and the Chen family have the same idea. They are worried about each other and need something to connect each other.
The eldest brother Chen Chusheng cannot be married and cannot be sacrificed, so his younger son is naturally the one who has to be sacrificed.
Chen Chuyang didn't feel much about this. Born in a family, one must have such awareness. Besides, he had no objection to this kind of thing. Shang Hongchen was pretty, so if she were that kind of ugly woman, she would be more or less opposed to it.
"It doesn't matter how I see it. At present, the merchant Shang Hongchen is not satisfied with you and wants to break off the engagement. I think she will definitely come to you. When the time comes, I need to know what you think?"
"After all, this engagement cannot be canceled casually. If you don't agree, then my father will never cancel it."
Chen Yuan wanted to make up for this son. On the one hand, breaking off the engagement would indeed affect his son's reputation and disgrace him. He would not be able to survive in Dragon Snake City in the future. As a father, he could not ignore his son's consideration.
On the other hand, he needs Chen Chuyang's attitude. If he agrees with it, then the marriage contract can be negotiated and his son can be compensated as much as possible.
"What if I want to cancel too?"
Chen Chuyang raised his head and looked at his father for the first time.
The father in his eyes has never changed, even after so many years.
"Do you really think so?"
Chen Yuan was stunned for a moment, not expecting that Chen Chuyang also had such thoughts.
Shang Hongchen was the great beauty of Dragon Snake City and the dream lover of many men. Chen Chuyang was engaged to her. Many people died of envy, and many people regarded Chen Chuyang as an enemy and kept targeting him.
"Hongchen is a good woman. Although she is a little willful now, she still has a good heart."
"Your mother and I like this girl very much. If she hadn't been attracted by the Tianxin Sect, your mother and I would be happy to have her as our daughter-in-law."
It could be seen that the two of them were very satisfied with Shang Hongchen.
Chen Chuyang listened silently and said nothing.
He heard his father's deeper meaning and said, "Listen to your father in everything."
"You don't regret it?"
Chen Yuan asked again.
"Once this matter is determined, there is no turning back, Hongchen..."
Chen Chuyang nodded: "Yes."
He doesn't want another woman to hinder his cultivation. It's just a woman, so don't do it.
As the saying goes, if there is no woman in my heart, I will draw my sword to nature.
He just wants to practice quietly, work hard to improve his cultivation, and strive to live forever as soon as possible.
All other things come after immortality.
